Keys

  ↑↓        select a task            Enter     task details
  F / L     follow a task's transcript
              ←→/Tab or #-# switch task   P task picker   [ ] earlier/later attempt
              ↑↓ PgUp/PgDn scroll   g oldest line   G newest line and follow again
              t expand tool output and subagent entries   T show thinking
              / search   n/N next/previous match   k cycle the kind filter
              scrolling past the top pages older entries in from disk   Esc/Q back
  U         usage: tokens, context, cost, time in tools per task    (S sort by cost)
  C         review what each task changed
              list: ↑↓ PgUp/PgDn select   g/G first/last   Enter open the hunks   O $VISUAL/$EDITOR   Esc back
              hunks: ↑↓ PgUp/PgDn scroll   g/G top/bottom   N/P hunk   ←→ file   O editor   Esc back to the list
  R         restart a failed, blocked, cancelled or skipped task
  Q         minimise the dashboard (the run continues; D reopens it)
  Ctrl+C    stop the run (twice to force)

  When a worker needs you, a prompt appears here automatically:
  Y allow   A allow for the rest of the task   N deny   R deny with a reason
  #-# / ↑↓ Enter choose an answer   T type an answer   N decline

Esc/Q back
